description:
Barack Obama stepped forward to defend the vaccine consensus against what he called continuously disproved claims about autism and drug safety, delivering the kind of smooth reassuring address that made him one of the most trusted political figures of his generation. Russell Brand responds by asking the questions Obama never answered: why the presence of mercury, why the presence of aluminium, why rising autism rates, and why no cases among the Amish. Behind the charm and the cadence, Russell argues, is a man whose allegiances run far deeper than public health.

author: Russell Brand
description:
A former FBI agent and current CIA official was caught on undercover footage telling a journalist that the bureau routinely practices entrapment, that you can put almost anyone in jail if you know what to do, and that the line between a legal operation and a setup is, in his own words, a fine line represented by a wiggly hand. When asked about Alex Jones by name, the official confirmed they were after him and stopped only because he had already been financially destroyed by a $100 million verdict. Russell Brand argues this is not a rogue confession but a rare moment of transparency about how Deep State machinery, legacy media, and shadowy agencies coordinate mass takedowns of public dissenting figures.
